Name: Invisible Valley
Author: stardemod
Description:
Invisible Valley transforms Stardew Valley into a memory game.

Starting at 6:10 AM, all NPCs, objects, crops, monsters, and most decorations become invisible, giving the player a unique challenge.

You can interact with the world normally, but everything is hidden, letting you focus on placement, planning, and exploration in a new way.

To temporarily reveal the world, you can sacrifice items by throwing them away. The visibility duration depends on the value of the items sacrificed. Your children are worth nothing. Don't even try.

Special exceptions like paths, fences, and other structural elements remain visible to allow navigation and organization.

This mod provides a unique, immersive challenge for players who want a different perspective on their farm and are tired of constantly using their eyes.
